title: Stage hypercover cohomology objects jointly generate the limit object
statement: Let S be a scheme, A a Grothendieck abelian category, F an A-valued small-etale sheaf on S, and D:I→Over(S) a small nonempty cofiltered diagram with qcqs stage schemes and affine transitions. Let c be a cone whose underlying scheme cone is a limit, and assume its vertex is qcqs. Fix q≥0 and use the actual hypercover cohomology object from [lem-weil-pbc-grothendieck-hypercover-model]. Set H_i=H_hyp^q((D_i→S)^*F) and H=H_hyp^q((c.pt→S)^*F). If B is an object of A and f,g:H→B satisfy a≫f=a≫g for every i and every a:H_i→H, then f=g. This is solely a statement about alternating cochain cohomology and finite-stage descent, with no injective resolutions or derived sections.

proof.text: Construct canonical stage and tail cochain maps with their hypercover-colimit injection equations. These maps use only units, inverse-image composition, base change and pullback pasting.

For a fixed stage hypercover, the explicit canonical tail section-short-complex cocone is colimiting in all three terms. AB5 makes short-complex homology preserve this filtered colimit. The hypothesis therefore equalizes f and g after the injection of its limit pullback.

For an arbitrary limit hypercover, descend only its finite truncation through q+1 and extend at a stage. The finite truncation isomorphism induces a finite refinement map, and its homology followed by the pulled-back-stage injection is the original hypercover injection. The preceding step thus equalizes f,g after every hypercover injection.

The injections into the actual hypercover cohomology colimit are jointly epic by the universal property of a colimit. Cancel them to conclude f=g. Double-opposite reindexing supplies exactly the filtered indexing convention required by finite hypercover descent.

theorem hypercoverCohomology_limit_hom_ext
    {S : Scheme.{u}} (F : Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology A)
    {I : Type u} [SmallCategory I] [IsCofiltered I] (D : I ⥤ Over S)
    [∀ i, CompactSpace (D.obj i).left]
    [∀ i, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i).left]
    [∀ {i j} (g : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map g).left]
    (c : Cone D) [CompactSpace c.pt.left] [QuasiSeparatedSpace c.pt.left]
    (hc : IsLimit ((Over.forget S).mapCone c)) (q : ℕ)
    (B : A)
    (f g : hypercoverCohomology A ((Etale.upperStar A c.pt.hom).obj F) q ⟶ B)
    (h : ∀ (i : I)
      (a : hypercoverCohomology A ((Etale.upperStar A (D.obj i).hom).obj F) q ⟶
        hypercoverCohomology A ((Etale.upperStar A c.pt.hom).obj F) q),
      a ≫ f = a ≫ g) : f = g
